notes: SorobanDelegateSignature holding itself 492 times, 1001 levels deep by the measured count against a limit of 1000 (1000 levels by the interpreter's count), counted by stellar-xdr. stellar-xdr refuses it under the corpus limit for TransactionEnvelope: one level too deep. Where the limit falls is implementation-defined, because decoders count levels differently: stellar-xdr counts every value it reads (each definition, number, optional, array and box), go-stellar-sdk counts one level per named type it decodes and takes the limit from the caller, js-xdr 5 counts structs, unions, arrays, optionals and type references against its own limit of 1500, and js-xdr 4 counts structs, unions, arrays and optionals against a limit of 200; neither js-xdr takes a limit from the stellar-sdk caller
